models_evaluated: EMR-interoperable image-based clinical decision support tool for cellulitis

links.outcome: Hospital admission for cellulitis and antibiotic use with vs without CDS engagement
links.effect: CDS engagement associated with reduced admissions (adjusted OR 0.62, 95% CI 0.40-0.97, p=0.04) and antibiotic use (adjusted OR 0.63, 95% CI 0.40-0.99); absolute admission reduction 7.1%; engagement 24.1%.
links.quote: CDS engagement was associated with decreased admissions for cellulitis and decreased antibiotic use in this study, despite low levels of CDS engagement.

screen.reason: The study evaluates the deployment of an image-based visual CDS tool in an EMR across 4 hospitals, comparing outcomes between clinicians who engaged vs did not engage with the tool itself, rather than evaluating a specific governance safeguard or deployment practice.
